instruction: Enable whitespace character visibility in the editor to spot formatting issues.

metadata.explanation: This task requires the agent to enable whitespace rendering in VSCode by setting 'editor.renderWhitespace' to 'all' in settings.json. The evaluator uses the existing check_json_settings metric. Task complexity matches the original: single setting modification through VSCode interface.
metadata.verification: Verified that check_json_settings metric can handle this setting check. Similar complexity to original task - modifying a single VSCode configuration.
